easyPrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard
description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing Karmic Guide.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Changeling Hero
Changeling Hero dies, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat from step 2.
